rows.grounds: compound of knowledge and self; nominative masculine singular form
optative of root bhū, third person singular active
nominative masculine singular agent noun from root dṛś

items.question: What becomes the seer of a living being once, O goddess?
items.inference: The knowledge-self becomes the seer of a living being once.
uncertainties: Exact doctrinal referent of vijñānātmā remains context-dependent
items.plain_english: O goddess, the knowledge-self may become the seer of a living being once.
